Description: Practical thread on cutting no-shows: two WhatsApp reminders, one-tap rescheduling, a waitlist. Points to the reminders demo.

1/ No-shows are a clinic's quietest leak. The doctor's time is paid for, the slot is gone, and the patient who wanted it was told "we're full".

3/ Fix 2: make rescheduling one tap. If cancelling means calling and waiting on the line, people just don't show up.
4/ Fix 3: keep a waitlist. When a slot opens, someone who wanted an earlier appointment gets it.
5/ Our WhatsApp Appointment Reminders handle the reminders and the reschedule link for you. Live demo: ferrnagency.com/marketplace
